t: 马格尼提乌斯将军被罗马贵族所宣称为皇帝,对康斯坦斯皇帝的统治不满.
te: General Magnentius is proclaimed emperor by Roman aristocrats discontent with the rule of emperor Constans.
dz: 马格尼提乌斯将军被罗马贵族所宣称为皇帝,对康斯坦斯皇帝的统治不满.
de: General Magnentius is proclaimed emperor by Roman aristocrats discontent with the rule of emperor Constans.

t: 韦特拉尼奥在被君士坦提乌斯二世的妹妹君士坦提纳所鼓励后自称为凯撒.
te: Vetranio proclaims himself Caesar after being encouraged to do so by Constantina, sister of Constantius II.
dz: 韦特拉尼奥在被君士坦提乌斯二世的妹妹君士坦提纳所鼓励后自称为凯撒.
de: Vetranio proclaims himself Caesar after being encouraged to do so by Constantina, sister of Constantius II.

dz: 君士坦丁王朝的罗马篡位者内波提亚努斯自封为罗马皇帝,以一群角斗士为首入罗马.
de: The Roman usurper Nepotianus, of the Constantinian dynasty, proclaims himself Roman emperor, entering Rome at the head of a group of gladiators.

dz: 韦特拉尼奥在纳伊苏斯(塞尔维亚)与君士坦提乌斯二世相会并被迫放弃他的帝国头衔. 君士坦提乌斯允许他作为私人公民靠国家养老金生活.
de: Vetranio meets Constantius II at Naissus (Serbia) and is forced to abdicate his imperial title. Constantius allows him to live as a private citizen on a state pension.
